headline: Haiku is now streaming on Netflix: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Tamil film, starring Aegan, Sridevi Apalla, Femina George, arrived on Netflix 4 weeks after opening in cinemas on 23 October.
paragraphs: Haiku is streaming on Netflix in India from 20 November.
That is 28 days after its theatrical release on 23 October — in line with the typical 28 days for Tamil films, based on 13 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.
A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.
Directed by Yuvaraj Chinnasamy, starring Aegan, Sridevi Apalla, Femina George, Adhirchi Arun, Subramanian Sethu. The film runs 143 minutes and is certified U/A 13+.
New on OTT re-checks Netflix's India listing every day; the page for Haiku has the latest on where to watch it.
